{{Top|leg}}
A '''plasma shield''' was a type of [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]]. They covered the maw of a [[World Devastator]]'s [[molecular furnace]] to protect the ship.<ref name="DESB">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> Plasma shields were also used to protect [[resonance torpedo]]es.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

[[All Terrain Experimental Transport|AT-XT walkers]] were equipped with plasma shield generators.<ref name="TCWCG">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref>
